name: Bonanza Megaways

features.name: Megaways
features.description: Each reel shows 2–7 symbols per spin, so the number of ways changes every spin.

features.name: Reactions
features.description: Winning symbols explode and new ones drop in.

features.name: Unlimited win multiplier
features.description: In free spins the multiplier rises by 1 after every reaction.

review: Bonanza launched the Megaways mechanic, and playing it now is a lesson in why the format took over. The constantly changing grid makes every spin look different, and the free spins multiplier increases with every cascade without resetting. It looks dated but plays well.
